div.p: This value set includes codes based on the following rules:

ul.li: Include codes fromhttp://snomed.info/sct version Not Stated (use latest from terminology server) where concept is-a 395218007 (Implantation of internal cardiac defibrillator)
Include codes fromhttp://snomed.info/sct version Not Stated (use latest from terminology server) where concept is-a 307280005 (Implantation of cardiac pacemaker)
Include codes fromhttp://snomed.info/sct version Not Stated (use latest from terminology server) where concept is-a 232967006 (LVAD - Implantation of left ventricular assist device)
Include codes fromhttp://snomed.info/sct version Not Stated (use latest from terminology server) where concept is-a 232966002 (RVAD - Implantation of right ventricular assist device)
Include codes fromhttp://snomed.info/sct version Not Stated (use latest from terminology server) where concept is-a 232968001 (BiVAD - Implantation of biventricular assist device)

title.value: MII VS Kardio Kardiale Devicemimplantation [SNOMED CT]

description.value: Dieses Value Set bildet die Implantation der kardialen Devices Kardioverter-Defibrillator (ICD), Herzschrittmacher zur kardialen Resynchronationstherapie (CRT) und ventrikuläre Unterstützungssysteme ab (VAD).

purpose.value: Codes aus diesem Value Set können in einer Prozedur die Implantation eines kardialen Devices in der Kardiologie spezifizieren.
